title: apcore Canonical Default Values
description: Single source of truth for all configuration default values across apcore SDK implementations. SDKs MUST use these values as fallbacks when no explicit configuration is provided.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory scan depth under extensions root.

follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during scanning.

root.description: Default schema files root directory path.

max_ref_depth.description: Maximum $ref recursion depth for schema resolution.

root.description: Default ACL configuration files directory path.

default_effect.description: Default ACL effect when no rule matches. MUST default to deny.

default_timeout.description: Default per-module execution timeout in milliseconds.

global_timeout.description: Default global timeout for the entire call chain in milliseconds.

max_call_depth.description: Maximum call chain depth before rejection.

max_module_repeat.description: Maximum times the same module ID can appear in a single call chain.

enabled.description: Whether system modules are enabled by default.

strategy.description: How the sampling decision is made (PROTOCOL_SPEC 10.7).

exporter.description: Trace exporter selected by name (PROTOCOL_SPEC 10.1.1 requirement 2).

otlp_endpoint.description: OTLP collector endpoint; null means the implementation's default.

max_merge_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for deep-merging streaming chunks. Prevents denial-of-service via deeply nested payloads.

validation.description: Declarative validation limits (PROTOCOL_SPEC 9.1.2). Every one is UNCONSTRAINED by default: apcore does not impose limits on the content its users author, it offers them. The recommended values live in the per-key descriptions of apcore-config.schema.json and in 9.1.2's table; they are recommendations, not defaults, deliberately. These six keys were declared in all three SDK key surfaces and read by none of them until v1.38.0 (apcore#118); they are recorded here now that they have a consumer, because config_key_governance.json pins each SDK's default table to THIS file. Five of the six carry NO `default` here on purpose: their unconstrained state is `null`, and `null` IS the absence of a default — carrying it through three SDK default tables would be noise that says nothing. Only `version_require_semver` has a real default value (false), so only it is a canonical default.

binding.description: Limits applied to binding files and module metadata when the content is read.

description_max_length.description: Maximum characters in a module `description`. null = no limit (recommended ceiling: 200).

documentation_max_length.description: Maximum characters in a module `documentation`. null = no limit (recommended ceiling: 5000).

tags_pattern.description: Regular expression every binding tag must match. null = no constraint. Defaulted off rather than to the recommended lowercase pattern, because enforcing it by default would add a rejection that does not exist today.

version_require_semver.description: Whether a binding `version` must be SemVer. false = no constraint, for the same reason tags_pattern defaults to null.

pipeline.description: Limits applied when the pipeline section is parsed.

step_name_max_length.description: Maximum characters in a pipeline step `name`. null = no limit (recommended ceiling: 64).

timeout_ms_max.description: Maximum value for a pipeline step `timeout_ms`. null = no bound (recommended ceiling: 300000).

dir.description: Default directory a binding loader scans when invoked without an explicit directory argument.

pattern.description: Default pattern binding files must match within `dir`. Glob dialect, matched with algorithm A25 (protocol-spec 9.2.3) against the FILENAME. Not path-typed: never resolved as a path itself.
